goal: Verify that a user can create a new account, save a private memo, and filter the memo list by selecting a specific date from the calendar.
instructions: On the 'Create your account' page, enter 'alice' into the 'Username' field and 'SecureP@ss123!' into the 'Password' field, then click the 'Sign up' button.
In the main dashboard, type 'Personal reminder for the weekend.' into the text input box labeled 'Any thoughts...', click the 'Private' button to set visibility, and then click the 'Save' button.
Click on the date '15' within the 'June 2026' calendar widget to filter the view for that specific day.
success_criteria: The user is successfully logged in and navigated to the main dashboard after account creation.
The memo 'Personal reminder for the weekend.' is visible in the feed with a timestamp of 'now'.
The calendar view updates to show the date '15' as selected.
The input box displays the selected date '2026-06-15' as a filter tag.
The memo list displays 'No data found' because no memos exist for the filtered date.
